page.overview:
What is Eclipsed Region?

The Eclipsed Region is a region located in Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is reached by traversing through Big Bridge. It is first visited in Chapter 17, "Naught but Nightmares" and is the starting location of Chapter 18, "The Fell Spell and the Quacho Queen".

Located in the north of the region. It is the first part of the region to be visited, after taking the Cactuar Express.

Located in the west of the region. It is not accessible upon first visit from the Eclipsed Region, but after talking to Cloud in the Library of the Ancients in Chapter 17, the entrance becomes accessible.

Located in the east, the train station atop the hill houses a line of the Cactuar Express that connects vertically into the continent directly above, and thus leads to the Besaid Region.
